nodes.Name: pmode
nodes.DocComment: A pmode value represents the current printer mode.

Fields.Name: commentNewline
Fields.DocComment: true if the comment group contains newlines

Fields.Name: level
Fields.DocComment: level == 0: outside composite literal; level > 0: inside composite literal

Fields.Name: impliedSemi
Fields.DocComment: if set, a linebreak implies a semicolon

Fields.Name: lastTok
Fields.DocComment: last token printed (token.ILLEGAL if it's whitespace)

Fields.Name: goBuild
Fields.DocComment: start index of all //go:build comments in output

Fields.Name: plusBuild
Fields.DocComment: start index of all // +build comments in output

Fields.Name: last
Fields.DocComment: value of pos after calling writeString

Fields.Name: linePtr
Fields.DocComment: if set, record out.Line for the next token in *linePtr

Fields.Name: sourcePosErr
Fields.DocComment: if non-nil, the first error emitting a //line directive

Fields.Name: useNodeComments
Fields.DocComment: if not set, ignore lead and line comments of nodes

nodes.Name: commentsHaveNewline
nodes.DocComment:
commentsHaveNewline reports whether a list of comments belonging to
an *ast.CommentGroup contains newlines. Because the position information
may only be partially correct, we also have to read the comment text.

nodes.Name: commentBefore
nodes.DocComment:
commentBefore reports whether the current comment group occurs
before the next position in the source code and printing it does
not introduce implicit semicolons.

nodes.Name: commentSizeBefore
nodes.DocComment:
commentSizeBefore returns the estimated size of the
comments on the same line before the next position.

nodes.Name: recordLine
nodes.DocComment:
recordLine records the output line number for the next non-whitespace
token in *linePtr. It is used to compute an accurate line number for a
formatted construct, independent of pending (not yet emitted) whitespace
or comments.

nodes.Name: linesFrom
nodes.DocComment:
linesFrom returns the number of output lines between the current
output line and the line argument, ignoring any pending (not yet
emitted) whitespace or comments. It is used to compute an accurate
size (in number of lines) for a formatted construct.

nodes.Name: writeLineDirective
nodes.DocComment: writeLineDirective writes a //line directive if necessary.

nodes.Name: writeIndent
nodes.DocComment: writeIndent writes indentation.

nodes.Name: writeByte
nodes.DocComment:
writeByte writes ch n times to p.output and updates p.pos.
Only used to write formatting (white space) characters.

nodes.Name: writeString
nodes.DocComment:
writeString writes the string s to p.output and updates p.pos, p.out,
and p.last. If isLit is set, s is escaped w/ tabwriter.Escape characters
to protect s from being interpreted by the tabwriter.

Note: writeString is only used to write Go tokens, literals, and
comments, all of which must be written literally. Thus, it is correct
to always set isLit = true. However, setting it explicitly only when
needed (i.e., when we don't know that s contains no tabs or line breaks)
avoids processing extra escape characters and reduces run time of the
printer benchmark by up to 10%.

nodes.Name: writeCommentPrefix
nodes.DocComment:
writeCommentPrefix writes the whitespace before a comment.
If there is any pending whitespace, it consumes as much of
it as is likely to help position the comment nicely.
pos is the comment position, next the position of the item
after all pending comments, prev is the previous comment in
a group of comments (or nil), and tok is the next token.

nodes.Name: isBlank
nodes.DocComment:
Returns true if s contains only white space
(only tabs and blanks can appear in the printer's context).

nodes.Name: commonPrefix
nodes.DocComment: commonPrefix returns the common prefix of a and b.

nodes.Name: trimRight
nodes.DocComment: trimRight returns s with trailing whitespace removed.

nodes.Name: stripCommonPrefix
nodes.DocComment:
stripCommonPrefix removes a common prefix from /*-style comment lines (unless no
comment line is indented, all but the first line have some form of space prefix).
The prefix is computed using heuristics such that is likely that the comment
contents are nicely laid out after re-printing each line using the printer's
current indentation.

nodes.Name: writeCommentSuffix
nodes.DocComment:
writeCommentSuffix writes a line break after a comment if indicated
and processes any leftover indentation information. If a line break
is needed, the kind of break (newline vs formfeed) depends on the
pending whitespace. The writeCommentSuffix result indicates if a
newline was written or if a formfeed was dropped from the whitespace
buffer.

nodes.Name: containsLinebreak
nodes.DocComment: containsLinebreak reports whether the whitespace buffer contains any line breaks.

nodes.Name: intersperseComments
nodes.DocComment:
intersperseComments consumes all comments that appear before the next token
tok and prints it together with the buffered whitespace (i.e., the whitespace
that needs to be written before the next token). A heuristic is used to mix
the comments and whitespace. The intersperseComments result indicates if a
newline was written or if a formfeed was dropped from the whitespace buffer.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: p.mode&noExtraBlank == 0 && last.Text[1] == '*' && p.lineFor(last.Pos()) == next.Line && tok != token.COMMA && (tok != token.RPAREN || p.prevOpen == token.LPAREN) && (tok != token.RBRACK || p.prevOpen == token.LBRACK)

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: last.Text[1] == '/' || tok == token.EOF || tok == token.RBRACE && p.mode&noExtraLinebreak == 0

nodes.Name: writeWhitespace
nodes.DocComment: writeWhitespace writes the first n whitespace entries.

nodes.Name: nlimit
nodes.DocComment: nlimit limits n to maxNewlines.

nodes.Name: print
nodes.DocComment:
print prints a list of "items" (roughly corresponding to syntactic
tokens, but also including whitespace and formatting information).
It is the only print function that should be called directly from
any of the AST printing functions in nodes.go.

Whitespace is accumulated until a non-whitespace token appears. Any
comments that need to appear before that token are printed first,
taking into account the amount and structure of any pending white-
space for best comment placement. Then, any leftover whitespace is
printed, followed by the actual token.

Children.Name: case
Children.RawSource: token.BREAK, token.CONTINUE, token.FALLTHROUGH, token.RETURN, token.INC, token.DEC, token.RPAREN, token.RBRACK, token.RBRACE

nodes.Name: flush
nodes.DocComment:
flush prints any pending comments and whitespace occurring textually
before the position of the next token tok. The flush result indicates
if a newline was written or if a formfeed was dropped from the whitespace
buffer.

nodes.Name: getDoc
nodes.DocComment: getDoc returns the ast.CommentGroup associated with n, if any.

nodes.Name: trimmer
nodes.DocComment:
A trimmer is an io.Writer filter for stripping tabwriter.Escape
characters, trailing blanks and tabs, and for converting formfeed
and vtab characters into newlines and htabs (in case no tabwriter
is used). Text bracketed by tabwriter.Escape characters is passed
through unchanged.

nodes.Name: Mode
nodes.DocComment: A Mode value is a set of flags (or 0). They control printing.

nodes.Name: normalizeNumbers
nodes.DocComment:
The mode below is not included in printer's public API because
editing code text is deemed out of scope. Because this mode is
unexported, it's also possible to modify or remove it based on
the evolving needs of go/format and cmd/gofmt without breaking
users. See discussion in CL 240683.

nodes.Name: Config
nodes.DocComment: A Config node controls the output of Fprint.

Fields.Name: Indent
Fields.DocComment: default: 0 (all code is indented at least by this much)

nodes.Name: printerPool
fprint
nodes.DocComment: fprint implements Fprint and takes a nodesSizes map for setting up the printer state.

nodes.Name: CommentedNode
nodes.DocComment:
A CommentedNode bundles an AST node and corresponding comments.
It may be provided as argument to any of the [Fprint] functions.

Fields.Name: Node
Fields.DocComment: *ast.File, or ast.Expr, ast.Decl, ast.Spec, or ast.Stmt

nodes.Name: Fprint
nodes.DocComment:
Fprint "pretty-prints" an AST node to output for a given configuration cfg.
Position information is interpreted relative to the file set fset.
The node type must be *[ast.File], *[CommentedNode], [][ast.Decl], [][ast.Stmt],
or assignment-compatible to [ast.Expr], [ast.Decl], [ast.Spec], or [ast.Stmt].

nodes.Name: Fprint
nodes.DocComment:
Fprint "pretty-prints" an AST node to output.
It calls [Config.Fprint] with default settings.
Note that gofmt uses tabs for indentation but spaces for alignment;
use format.Node (package go/format) for output that matches gofmt.
